criteria.text: A deterministic Chromium scenario clicks Продолжить к уточнениям and proves the follow-up request cannot start until business-context and progress synchronization completes.
The browser scenario observes the loading status, the rendered follow-up question with completeness, and the ready-for-generation review state.
The synthetic fixture performs no live generation or paid request, and focused Playwright, ESLint, pnpm type-check, and pnpm build all pass.
